title: Scanner-Induced Domain Shifts Undermine the Robustness of Pathology Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the robustness of feature extractors to scanner-induced domain shifts through unsupervised quantitative geometric analysis of the embedding space (e.g., pairwise cosine distance, 1-NN match rate, Mantel correlation) and supervised downstream evaluation of predictive consistency (Fleiss' Kappa) and probability calibration stability across five different whole-slide scanner devices.
